guideline.name: Penguin Call Annotation Guide (MVP Binary Classification Dataset)

columns.name: Selection
columns.description: Raven selection number. Whole number, unique within the table.

columns.name: View
columns.message: should be a spectrogram view (e.g. "Spectrogram 1"); waveform views are no longer used
columns.description: Raven view the selection was drawn in. Spectrogram only.

columns.name: Begin Time (s)
columns.description: Start of the selection, in seconds.

columns.name: End Time (s)
columns.description: End of the selection, in seconds.

columns.name: Low Freq (Hz)
columns.description: Lower frequency bound of the selection, in Hz.

columns.name: High Freq (Hz)
columns.description: Upper frequency bound of the selection, in Hz.

columns.name: Annotation
columns.description: Primary sound category. "still" = quiet background with no wind/rain/ocean. Use "unknown" only when a sound clearly is not one of the others and cannot be placed. Never identify non-penguin species: use "other_species".

columns.name: call_type
columns.description: Penguin vocalisation type. Only used when Annotation = penguin.

columns.name: condition
columns.description: Background condition overlapping a penguin call. Only filled when Annotation = penguin and something else is happening at the same time. Combine several with "+" (e.g. other_species+wind).

columns.name: distance
columns.description: Estimated distance of the penguin call from the song meter. Only applies when Annotation = penguin.

columns.name: count
columns.message: must be a whole number (1, 2, 3...) or a range such as >1, >2, >3
columns.description: Number of penguins calling. Exact number if certain; otherwise a range (>1, >2, >3...). Only applies when Annotation = penguin.

columns.name: Score
columns.description: Optional detector score added by this tool. Not part of the annotation guideline.

conditionalRules.message: is required when Annotation is penguin
must be empty when Annotation is not penguin
